arxiv-2112-06264.title: Electromagnetic form factors of neutron and neutral stange hyperons in the oscillating view of point
arxiv-2112-06264.creator: An-Xin Dai, Zhong-Yi Li, Lei Chang, Ju-Jun Xie
arxiv-2112-06264.description: Abstract Based on the recently precise measurements of the electron-positron annihilation reactions into a neutron and anti-neutron pair by BESIII collaboration, the effective form factor of neutron was determined in the time like region, and it was found that the effective form factor of neutron is smaller than the ones of proton.

arxiv-2206-06394.title: Stable anisotropic minimal hypersurfaces in 𝐑 4 \mathbf{R}^{4}
arxiv-2206-06394.creator: Otis Chodosh, Chao Li
arxiv-2206-06394.description: Abstract . We show that a complete, two-sided, stable immersed anisotropic minimal hypersurface in 𝐑 4 \mathbf{R}^{4} has intrinsic cubic volume growth, provided the parametric elliptic integral is C 2 C^{2} -close to the area functional. We also obtain an interior volume upper bound for stable anisotropic minimal hypersurfaces in the unit ball.

arxiv-2301-00251.title: Feature Selection for Personalized Policy Analysis
arxiv-2301-00251.creator: Maria Nareklishvili, Nicholas Polson, Vadim Sokolov
arxiv-2301-00251.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose Forest-PLS, a feature selection method for analyzing policy effect heterogeneity in a more flexible and comprehensive manner than is typically available with conventional methods. In particular, our method is able to capture policy effect heterogeneity both within and across subgroups of the population defined by observable characteristics.

arxiv-2406-12418.title: Counting subgraphs in locally dense graphs
arxiv-2406-12418.creator: Domagoj Bradač, Benny Sudakov, Yuval Wigderson
arxiv-2406-12418.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Domagoj Bradač, Benny Sudakov, Yuval Wigderson. A graph G G is said to be p p -locally dense if every induced subgraph of G G with linearly many vertices has edge density at least p p . A famous conjecture of Kohayakawa, Nagle, Rödl, and Schacht predicts that locally dense graphs have, asymptotically, at least as many copies of any fixed graph H H as are found in a random graph of edge density p p .

arxiv-2406-15064.title: Deep Learning-Based Detection and Segmentation of Edge-On and Highly Inclined Galaxies Facilities: Sloan APLpy ( Robitaille & Bressert 2012 ; Robitaille 2019 ) , astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , astroquery ( Ginsb
arxiv-2406-15064.creator: Ž. Chrobáková, V. Krešňáková, R. Nagy, J. Gazdová, P. Butka
arxiv-2406-15064.description: Abstract Edge-on galaxies have many important applications in galactic astrophysics, but they can be difficult to identify in vast amounts of astronomical data. To facilitate the search for them, we developed a deep learning algorithm designed to identify and extract edge-on galaxies from astronomical images.

arxiv-2503-18805.title: Virtual Reality in Manufacturing Education: A Scoping Review Indicating State-of-the-Art, Benefits, and Challenges Across Domains, Levels, and Entities
arxiv-2503-18805.creator: Ananya Ipsita, Ramesh Kaki, Ziyi Liu, Mayank Patel, Runlin Duan, Lakshmi Deshpande, Lin-Ping Yuan, Victoria Lowell, Dr. Ashok Maharaj, Kylie Peppler, Steven Feiner, Karthik Ramani
arxiv-2503-18805.description: Abstract To address the shortage of a skilled workforce in the U.S. manufacturing industry, immersive Virtual Reality (VR)-based training solutions hold promising potential. To effectively utilize VR to meet workforce demands, it is important to understand the role of VR in manufacturing education. Therefore, we conduct a scoping review in the field.

arxiv-2507-08637.title: Scaling Attention to Very Long Sequences in Linear Time with Wavelet-Enhanced Random Spectral Attention ( WERSA )
arxiv-2507-08637.creator: Vincenzo Dentamaro
arxiv-2507-08637.description: Abstract Transformer models are computationally costly on long sequences since regular attention has quadratic O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) time complexity. We introduce Wavelet-Enhanced Random Spectral Attention ( WERSA ), a novel mechanism of linear O ⁡ ( n ) O(n) time complexity that is pivotal to enable successful long-sequence processing without the performance trade-off.

arxiv-2509-14304.title: Deploying UDM Series in Real-Life Stuttered Speech Applications: A Clinical Evaluation Framework
arxiv-2509-14304.creator: Eric Zhang, Li Wei, Sarah Chen, Michael Wang
arxiv-2509-14304.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Eric Zhang, Li Wei, Sarah Chen, Michael Wang. Stuttered and dysfluent speech detection systems have traditionally suffered from the trade-off between accuracy and clinical interpretability. While end-to-end deep learning models achieve high performance, their black-box nature limits clinical adoption. This paper looks at the Unconstrained Dysfluency Modeling (UDM) series—the current state-of-the-art framework developed by Berkeley that combines modular architecture, explicit phoneme alignment, and interpretable outputs for real-world clinical deployment.

pmc-10795579.creator: Deninson Alejandro Vargas, David J. Gregory, Roni Nitzan Koren, Dan Zilberstein, Ashton Trey Belew, Najib M. El-Sayed, María Adelaida Gómez

pmc-12045234.creator: Fehim Can Sevil, Mehmet Tort, Necip Becit, Serkan Güme, Nigar Madatlı
pmc-12045234.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to describe the cases treated with endovascular aortic aneurysm repair (EVAR) and thoracic endovascular aneurysm repair (TEVAR) and their results in our clinic.Methods This retrospective study included 30 patients (26 males, 4 females; mean age: 62.46 ±16.17 years; range, 18 to 77 years) who underwent endovascular repair for aortic aneurysms between July 2020 and June 2024.

pmc-12546786.title: Ectopic cervical thymus in a child: A rare neck mass case report
pmc-12546786.creator: Wail Alqatta
pmc-12546786.description: Introduction and ImportanceEctopic cervical thymus is a rare congenital anomaly caused by aberrant thymic migration. It commonly presents in the pediatric population as a neck mass and is often misdiagnosed due to its nonspecific clinical features.Case presentationThis report describes a 12-year-old female presenting with a progressively enlarging, painful mass in the left lower cervical region over four months.

pmc-12573373.title: Interactions between ENDS and cigarette use: evidence from a 2022 national telephone survey in South Africa
pmc-12573373.creator: Kirsten van der Zee, Corné Van Walbeek
pmc-12573373.description: IntroductionElectronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) may serve as a cessation tool for people who smoke cigarettes. However, for people who do not smoke, ENDS may be a gateway to nicotine addiction and cigarette use. This paper aims to quantify these behaviours in South Africa.MethodsWe analysed a nationally representative telephone survey of 21 263 South Africans living in urban areas.

pmc-12618362.title: Therapeutic Advances in Hereditary Angioedema: A Focus on Present and Future Options
pmc-12618362.creator: Kelsey Uminski, Dawn Goodyear, Stephen Betschel
pmc-12618362.description: Hereditary angioedema (HAE) is a rare genetic disorder characterized by unpredictable and potentially life-threatening episodes of swelling, driven primarily by excessive bradykinin production. These episodes commonly involve the skin, gastrointestinal tract, and upper airway, significantly impacting patients’ quality of life.

pmc-13103678.title: Interpretable machine learning in type-2 diabetes prediction in patients with depressive symptoms: Insights from mendelian randomization and physical activity
pmc-13103678.creator: Zhao Li, Xiaoming Qiu, Wenzhong Wu, Hyunsik Kang
pmc-13103678.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to examine the causal relationship between depression and type-2 diabetes (T2D) and to develop a machine-learning (ML)-driven risk prediction model for T2D.MethodsThis cross-sectional study performed forward and reverse Mendelian randomization (MR) and multivariable MR (MVMR) analyses using GWAS summary data.

pmc-13398654.title: A Delphi Consensus on Clinical Features, Diagnosis, and Treatment of Chronic Rhinosinusitis With Nasal Polyps in the ASEAN Region
pmc-13398654.creator: Baharudin Abdullah, Revadi Govindaraju, Salina Husain, Jin Keat Siow, Pongsakorn Tantilipikorn, Neville Wei Yang Teo, De Yun Wang, Deasi Anggraini, Tze Choong Charn, Chao‐Wu David Chin, Dichapong Kanjanawasee, Maung Maung Khaing, Jern‐Lin Leong, Luan Viet Tran, Harvinder Singh, Ing Ping Tang, Kim Th
pmc-13398654.description: BackgroundChronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) impacts patients' concentration, ability to work, and overall quality of life. Current treatment options include topical and oral medications, and surgery. Recent evidence supports the efficacy of biologics in improving symptoms and quality of life. This study addresses the lack of consensus in the ASEAN region, providing guidance for otolaryngologists on appropriate CRSwNP management.

uslaw-usc-t3-s303.title: 3 U.S.C. § 303 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t3-s303.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t3-s303.description: United States Code, Title 3 (The President); Chapter 4 (Delegation Of Functions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. As used in this chapter, the term “function” embraces any duty, power, responsibility, authority, or discretion vested in the President or other officer concerned, and the terms “perform” and “performance” may be construed to mean “exercise”.
